scientific_claim: With balanced exposure to all eight hidden motifs and the WBG-2 selector otherwise unchanged, Wingless recovered all eight predictive raw-byte motifs, achieved perfect held-out motif successor prediction, causally outperformed both byte-only and shuffled-motif controls by 0.875 accuracy, and reduced effective evaluation events by 37.5%.
relationship_to_r2: R2 remains a valid negative under its collapsed corpus. The supported R3 paired comparison demonstrates that the selector succeeds when motif support is complete, consistent with the sealed attribution.
next_question: Can Wingless invoke learned coarse motif representations selectively in predictable regions while retaining byte-level processing in high-uncertainty regions, reducing compute at matched quality?
scope: bounded synthetic raw-byte motif discovery and causal aggregation
